visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) The video begins in a modern apartment living room where a large golden retriever wearing a harness stands curiously amidst a scattered array of cardboard boxes on the wooden floor. A woman in a grey t-shirt and denim shorts is seen squatting, preparing to work on the boxes, while a white sewing machine sits on a table in the background. (2) The scene shifts to a professional indoor toy car racing facility with multiple grey lanes and colorful numbered starting positions. A woman and a young boy in a yellow and grey shirt are crouched by the track, adjusting a small motorized car. The lighting is bright and industrial, reflecting off the smooth plastic surfaces of the elaborate track system. (3) Inside a retail toy shop, the camera focuses on shelves packed with Tamiya brand four-wheel-drive model car boxes. A child's hand reaches for a 'Blast Arrow' model, and later, the boy is shown with a wide-eyed, excited expression, sticking his tongue out in delight while holding a plush toy. The woman holds up various model boxes, including 'Cosmosonic,' to the camera for close-up inspection. (4) Back in the home setting, a time-lapse sequence shows the woman meticulously building a custom track. She uses a black marker to trace lines on large flat cardboard sheets, then employs a utility knife to cut out curved sections. Her hands are shown precisely applying thick red adhesive tape to join the cardboard walls to the floor of the track. (5) The final phase shows the completed DIY cardboard track, which features long straightaways and a large U-turn near a TV stand. A toddler in a red shirt and the golden retriever watch as two miniature cars race through the homemade course. The woman continues to reinforce the structure with tape as the children and dog interact with the new play area.

Short 'whoosh' and 'ding' sound effects punctuate the transitions as the narrator introduces the trip to the racing school. (2) As the scene moves to the racing track, the high-pitched whirring of electric motors from miniature 4WD cars is heard, blending with the rhythmic BGM. The narrator's tone is bright and enthusiastic, reflecting excitement. (3) In the toy shop, low-level ambient chatter and the faint rustle of cardboard boxes can be heard. A young boy's voice enters briefly with a soft, curious tone as he reacts to the toys. (4) During the DIY montage, the sound of a metal knife slicing through cardboard creates short, sharp percussive sounds, followed by the distinctive adhesive rip of wide plastic tape being pulled from a roll. (5) The final phase features the overlapping sounds of motorized toy cars racing on cardboard, the narrator's celebratory closing remarks, and a final upbeat musical swell as the video concludes.
